title: pvFlashReader
body:
## pvFlashReader

Reads output of the FLASH astrophysics code (HDF5 plot or checkpoint files) into an overlapping AMR (hierarchical box) dataset: nested refinement levels of uniform blocks with cell-centred variables. Level sets the finest level loaded, counted from the root level 0 (ParaView default 1), and every variable starts disabled, so name the ones you need in CellArrayStatus. Several files form a time series. For particles use pvFLASHAMRParticlesReader; to analyse on a uniform grid, follow with pvResampleToImage or pvResampleAMR.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The native help text says this reader loads 'Enzo format'; that is a copy error in the ParaView XML. It reads FLASH files; use pvEnzoReader for Enzo.
- Level 1 shows only the two coarsest levels; raise it (up to the file's level count) before measuring fine-scale features, accepting more memory.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `FlashReader`. Identity: `sources/FlashReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the cell-centred variables to load from the FLASH file, such as density or pressure fields. Listing names loads exactly those arrays and disables every other array the file offers; an empty list loads none. Fewer arrays mean less memory and faster reads. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `EnableCaching` | Keep AMR blocks that have already been read in memory, so later updates that change the level or array selection, or revisit a time, do not reread them from disk. It does not change the data produced. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Level` | This property specifies the desired level of resolution that will be visible. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of point-centred arrays to load. This reader lists only cell-centred variables from the file (its array setup registers cell arrays only), so there is normally nothing to select here; use CellArrayStatus and convert with cellToPoint if you need point data. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvFlashReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
